findings.label: Dead engine arm for status=='duplicate'
findings.description: cuco_care_sync_engine.dart line 183 retains the old `opResult.status == 'duplicate'` arm alongside the new `opResult.isDuplicate` check. The server no longer returns that status string after migration 0019 so the arm is dead, but it misrepresents the protocol contract. Remove once migration 0019 is live everywhere.

findings.label: Feed screen widget tests absent
findings.description: plan step 10e (widget tests for loading/empty/error states and validation in RecordFeedTransactionSheet) was not created. Not in the five-file acceptance criterion but called for in spec Part F. Form-validation UI binding (_isValid guard) is untested at the widget level.
